01 — 5:40 am, the first pan

Ginger first.Always pounded.

Every spice goes into the water whole and bruised, never as a powder — then two heaped spoons of Assam.

  • Gingerpounded, not grated
  • Green cardamompods split by hand
  • Clovethree, no more
  • Cinnamonone curl of bark
  • Black pepperfor the back of the throat
  • Assam CTCtwo heaped spoons

03 — Milked

Then the milk,all at once.

Full-cream buffalo milk, straight into the rolling tea. No water-to-milk maths on a napkin.

04 — Boiled

Boiled upthree times.

Let it climb to the rim, drop the flame, let it climb again. That is where the colour comes from.

Eleven minutes · never less

05 — Poured

Pulled froma height.

The long pour cools it a degree, wakes up the froth and — let's be honest — looks fantastic.

The house rules

How we brew. And why we don’t negotiate.

In 1950 or 2026, Fort moves at one speed and chai moves at another. We take eleven minutes per batch because nine is under-steeped and twelve turns bitter.
Rule 03 — The Long Pull

One metre from pan to rim.

Wakes up the aromatic cardamom oils and aerates the malai into silk.

Bruised whole
Always 9 jars
FIG 01.1 — GLASS BLUEPRINTSCALE 1:1

The traditional Mumbai cutting glass: 18 pressed flutes allow you to hold boiling tea without burning your fingers. Heavy base prevents tipping on marble tables.

01

Pounded, never powdered

Old-crop ginger pounded in brass mortars every 2 hours. Powder dries out the soul.

02

Three boils, no fewer

The milk must climb the lip of the steel saucepan three distinct times before straining.

03

Three seconds on the dunk

Glucose biscuits forgive nothing past 3.2 seconds. Have respect for structural engineering.

04

No laptops before 10 am

Mornings in Fort belong to newspapers, conversation, and second cups.

A day at the tapri

  1. 6:00First boil. Ginger gets pounded, the shutters go up.
  2. 8:30Bun maska comes out of the oven. Office crowd, two deep.
  3. 13:00Keema pav till it runs out — usually by half past.
  4. 16:30The rush. Four hundred cuttings in an hour.
  5. 23:00Last pour. The pan gets scrubbed for tomorrow.
